description: This file contains definitions for managing documents, directories, and related content in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for directories, files, content types, and configuration wizards.

classes.name: node_class
classes.description: Represents a URI node, either content, collection, or file, with methods to navigate and retrieve content.

classes.name: document_directory
classes.description: Model for managing directories in the document management system, including hierarchy, duplication checks, and resource path generation.

classes.name: document_directory_node
classes.description: Inherits process.node, adds a link to a document directory.

classes.name: document_directory_content_type
classes.description: Model for defining types of directory content, such as file extensions.

classes.name: document_directory_content
classes.description: Model for directory content entries, including file suffixes, report associations, and PDF processing.

classes.name: ir_action_report_xml
classes.description: Extension of report actions to link reports with models.

classes.name: document_file
classes.description: Extends ir.attachment to handle file storage, indexing, and duplication checks.

classes.name: document_configuration_wizard
classes.description: Wizard for configuring server and directory settings, including IP detection and resource setup.

methods.name: random_name
methods.description: Generates a random string of 10 ASCII letters.

methods.name: create_directory
methods.description: Creates a new directory with a random name at the specified path.
